template.name: True Scalper Profit Lock
template.notes: Fast EMAs plus the documented two-period RSI filter drive the long, with the opposite EMA cross or a lost RSI filter closing it; FastPeriod, SlowPeriod and RsiThreshold are not given, so 5, 20 and 50 are fallbacks. TakeProfitPoints/StopLossPoints, the abandon-after-N-candles timer, break-even moves and money management are not percentage or DSL fields.
